description: Late endgame (about ply 26+) where play is confined to at most three open columns, typically one nearly empty column (most strongly the center) with the rest of the board full, and the player to move is lost by force, usually because the opponent's threat cells in that column fall on the opponent's turn. Fires on alternate plies (the losing side's turns). Lost positions with 4+ open columns do not fire; some 1-2-column endgames fire even when not lost.
effect: Pushes the move toward the nearly empty column: forced high in a non-firing endgame it moved 0.95 probability from the winning column 1 to the empty center column; +0.08 to the empty column in another. Zeroing it in firing positions changes nothing measurable (the move there is usually forced).
notes: Threat-geometry rules failed (stacked opponent threats F1 0.21; parity-row zugzwang threat F1 0.15 with recall 0.83; threat-count difference F1 0.25). Exact endgame solver 'side to move is lost, ply>=28' F1 0.395 AUROC 0.85; adding 'at most 3 legal columns' F1 0.481 (P 0.38, R 0.66), AUROC 0.81. Simulation share negative (-0.79) for all level schemes. Misses include winning/drawn positions with 1-2 columns left (e.g. immediate win in last column). Best synthesis 16.4 (only center column left, lost), below dev max 18.7. Two score calls were wasted by accidental re-runs.
